admin.title: Plugins
admin.subtitle: Signed plugins from the central marketplace. Crewhall never runs plugin code; a plugin runs on its own server, within the limits you approve.
admin.empty: No plugin on the marketplace matches.
admin.catalogError: The marketplace could not be reached.
admin.installHint: The plugin runs on its own server ({origin}). Acting for a person it never goes beyond what they may do; it is limited to the permissions below.
admin.entry: Where it shows up in Crewhall

entryPoints.cards: {count, plural, one {# home card} other {# home cards}}

admin.updateNeeds: The new version asks for more permissions. The ticked ones are granted; the rest are not, and the plugin works without them.
admin.uninstallConfirm: Remove {name}? Its server is told the installation was removed; its tabs, cards and commands disappear.
admin.partialHint: Unticked permissions are not granted. The plugin is told what it was granted; some of its features may not work.
admin.permissionsHint: Choose which of the permissions the plugin asks for are granted. The plugin is told, and new session tokens follow it.
admin.byRefHint: For plugins not in the catalog (unlisted or private to your organization): paste the plugin id the publisher gave you or the marketplace's install link.
admin.installHintSelf: This plugin runs on your organization's own server. Crewhall checks that the server serves the signed manifest and talks only to that address.
admin.selfOriginHint: An https address without a path. The server must serve the manifest the marketplace signed, with its own address, at /.well-known/crewhall-plugin.json.
admin.browserHint: The plugin's tabs and cards may ask only for the ticked ones; the person still answers the browser's own prompt.

frame.title: {name} plugin
frame.notFound: This plugin is not installed or is turned off.

offline.title: Let {name} work in the background?
offline.body: {name} will act for you while you are away, within your own rights and the plugin's permissions: syncing boards and updating cards. What it does appears under your name with the plugin's badge. You can turn it off any time in Notification settings › Plugins.
offline.setting: Work for me in the background

prefs.hint: Where its notifications reach you and whether it shows in the mobile app. Saved to your account.
